description: Rules that group feature names into collections for browsing. Assignments are INFERRED from a feature's internal name (word match) or, failing that, from the binary it was found in. They are a browsing aid only: they say nothing about what a feature does, whether it is visible, or whether it is safe to change. Collections are checked in order; the first name rule that matches wins, then the first binary rule. A curated catalog entry with a cited category always overrides these rules. Words match whole words of the name split at capital letters, digits and underscores ("TaskbarAutoHide" = taskbar auto hide), so "start menu" does not match "Restart".
